items.title: Marvell makes major board move ahead of $115 billion AI deal
items.summary: The chipmaker expands its board to 10 members as it prepares for a major deal in optical networking.

items.title: Microsoft Is Fighting a Ban on Chinese Parts Inside AI Data Centers
items.summary: Microsoft took its fight against a proposed FCC transceiver ban straight to the White House, yet the stock barely flinched while optical suppliers surged. The real story hinges on a speed threshold and a date years away.

items.title: AI’s Central Bank Is in Crisis. Intel and These Stocks Are Feeling the Pain.
items.summary: Intel stock falls along with Marvell, Lumentum, and Coherent after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned. Here's why that is bad news.

items.title: Lumentum Trades Below Marvell’s Buyout Offer. Is the Gap a Bargain?
items.summary: Lumentum's revenue is more than doubling, yet its stock now moves with Marvell's shares and a regulatory clock that runs into 2028. Who actually profits from the discount, and what could erase it?

items.title: Coherent Soars 20% in a Week as Its Growth Guide Outlasts the AI Selloff: “Basically Booked Out”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares rose 20% in the past week, as its 50% revenue growth outlasted a midterm selloff. Management guides to more than 60% pro forma revenue growth in fiscal 2027.

items.title: Marvell Acquires Lumentum in Blockbuster $80 Billion Deal
items.summary: There has been no shortage of news these last few weeks coming out of the memory and optics sectors in regards to AI investing. Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith are here to break down just a few of them, including Marvell's purchase of Lumentum in a huge $80 billion deal. Marvell has enjoyed a nice surge since the acquisition - one of the largest in tech history - and the company has a history of needing to reshape its brand and business which could be helpful. The two also shared some updates in regards to companies including Micron, Semtech and Alphabet, as well as what investors can expect from them as we move into 2027.

items.title: Lumentum Stocks Jump 14.85% as AI Optics Rebound Narrows Marvell Deal Gap
items.summary: Each Lumentum share converts into 4.5 Marvell shares, and Wednesday's rally reshapes the arbitrage spread.

items.title: Marvell Technology Stocks Surge 12.22% as AI Optics Rally Eases Lumentum Deal Doubts
items.summary: Marvell shares recover part of their post-deal slide as investors revisit the $115 billion AI connectivity bet.
